problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Parcels:
* Package 1: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 53 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 48 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 47 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 44 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 55 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 33 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 68 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 66 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 31 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 35 cubic feet
* Package 24: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 25: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 26: size 65 cubic feet
* Package 27: size 41 cubic feet
* Package 28: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 29: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 30: size 31 cubic feet
* Package 31: size 53 cubic feet
* Package 32: size 48 cubic feet
* Package 33: size 52 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum cargo capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
